scope: Instrumented direct replica (no worker), real PostgreSQL journal; diagnostic only, all post-warmup samples

summary.stage: metadata
apply
codec
encodeSize
BEGIN

SELECT l.id FROM collaboration_leadership l WHERE id=1 AND owner=$1 AND epoch=$2 AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks WHERE locktype='advisory' AND granted AND pid=l.backend_pid AND classid=$3::oid AND objid=(hashtext(current_schema())::bigint & 4294967295)::oid AND objsubid=2) FOR SHARE OF l
SELECT id FROM pages WHERE id=$1 AND workspace_id=$2 FOR NO KEY UPDATE

WITH RECURSIVE candidates AS (
 SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS c(key text,userid uuid,session uuid,workspace uuid,page uuid)
 ), ancestors AS (
 SELECT c.key,p.id,p.parent_id,p.deleted_at,p.workspace_id,1 AS depth FROM candidates c JOIN pages p ON p.id=c.page AND p.workspace_id=c.workspace
 UNION ALL SELECT a.key,p.id,p.parent_id,p.deleted_at,p.workspace_id,a.depth+1 FROM ancestors a JOIN pages p ON p.id=a.parent_id AND p.workspace_id=a.workspace_id WHERE a.depth<51
 ) SELECT c.key,actor.id AS actor FROM candidates c
 JOIN auth_sessions s ON s.id=c.session AND s.user_id=c.userid JOIN auth_users u ON u.id=s.user_id
 JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=c.workspace AND w.deleted_at IS NULL
 JOIN LATERAL(SELECT id FROM actors WHERE workspace_id=c.workspace AND user_id=c.userid AND kind='user' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1) actor ON true
 WHERE s.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND u.email_verified AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members m WHERE m.workspace_id=c.workspace AND m.user_id=c.userid AND m.role IN ('owner','member'))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ancestors a WHERE a.key=c.key) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ancestors a WHERE a.key=c.key AND (a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR a.depth>50))
SELECT content_revision FROM collaboration_documents WHERE page_id=$1 AND generation=$2

INSERT INTO collaboration_block_ids(id,page_id) SELECT id,$2 FROM unnest($1::uuid[]) AS input(id) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM collaboration_block_ids known WHERE known.id=input.id AND known.page_id=$2) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING
SELECT id FROM collaboration_block_ids WHERE id=ANY($1::uuid[]) AND page_id=$2

INSERT INTO collaboration_receipts(workspace_id,page_id,generation,actor_id,receipt,revision,update_hash,request_hash) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8) ON CONFLICT(page_id,generation,actor_id,receipt) DO UPDATE SET receipt=EXCLUDED.receipt RETURNING revision,update_hash
INSERT INTO collaboration_updates(workspace_id,page_id,generation,revision,update) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)

UPDATE collaboration_documents SET content_revision=$2,journal_bytes=journal_bytes+$3,updated_at=clock_timestamp(),projection_first_pending_at=coalesce(projection_first_pending_at,clock_timestamp()),projection_due_at=least(clock_timestamp()+interval '1 second',coalesce(projection_first_pending_at,clock_timestamp())+interval '5 seconds') WHERE page_id=$1
COMMIT
